text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after Mejiro Ardan's debut
race, I pay
her a visit while she
recuperates at her family's
rest house.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
I presume you're here to see Lady
Ardan? Allow
me to lead the way.
choice_data_list: Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow after Mejiro Ardan's nanny and,
a short distance from the rest house, we
reach a small
woodland area where
Mejiro Ardan is relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hello there, Trainer. How lovely that
you've come
to see me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's absolutely fine. The chief physician
said that I've regained my strength and
am at least as
healthy as I was before my
debut.
choice_data_list: ...How's your body feeling?
...How are you feeling physically?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, would you care to take a nice,
relaxing
stroll with me?
choice_data_list: That's good to hear.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I wish to speak with you in private.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan takes me to an elevated
clearing on
a small hill past the woods.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This moment, right now, is a critical
juncture for
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I can hazard a good guess at how your

conversation with my physician went the
other
day.
choice_data_list: Does that meanâ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The man is my family's most esteemed
physician, and I've known him since I was
little. As such, I
trust him as much as I do
Nanny.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And accordingly, anything he's said
regarding my
condition... is to be
trusted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That said...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Even if his concerns regarding my body
are
justified... and even if the path I
tread is as
treacherous as thin ice...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shan't ever give up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: But of course, this decision reflects only my wishes... and not yours, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Ardan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I believe that by now, you must know all
too well how unreliable and hazy an
individual I can be. I
even collapsed
after my debut race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if you do choose to stay by my
side...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You'll be managing a racer as fragile and
delicate
as a glass ornament.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Could you still adorn me on the track...
knowing
that you might end up breaking
me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: There is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan looks at me like she's
puzzling something over. I've already
decided how I'm
going to answer her
question.
choice_data_list: Still, I would never break it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You've... something to show me?
choice_data_list: There's something I want you to see.
There's something I want you to see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take out my tablet and hand it to
Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Is this... a race agenda... and a training
regimen?
And not just one, but multiple
variations?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Th-this can't be—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: That's my resolve.
That's my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The tablet I showed Mejiro Ardan
contains a slew of race agendas and
training plans I've devised
for her junior
year and onwards.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Those plans also incorporate every
foreseeable scenario I could think of
pertaining to Mejiro
Ardan's health and
well-being.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Does this mean... You
understood what I
was trying to say?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Of course I do. The way she's testing me
with this talk of consequences... I know
she's just pushing
me away out of
kindness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The thing is, I don't want kindness. I
want
something else...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: I want to stay Ardan's Trainer.
I want to be Ardan's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's because I want to remain as her
trainer that I've thought about what I
should do in that role,
and what she
might want from me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide that now's the time to put my
answer into
words. As Mejiro Ardan's
trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her trainer, I'll make sure to protect
her fragile body, so she'll be able to
shine on in all her races,
now and
forever.
choice_data_list: I won't let your light be extingui...
I won't let your light fade away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And to help her—this racer who lives in
the
moment, and only has eyes for the
now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: I will paint your âfuture.â
I will paint your 'future'.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It was after my debut race... The evening
of the
day I was transferred to the family
rest house...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...That night, I had a dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In my dream, I heard the sound of glass
cracking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The sensation of everything spilling out
from my
fractured body was so cold, so
vivid...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't put that dream behind me...
And so today, I found myself
questioning you, in a
manner most
uncouth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I'm truly, terribly sorry for that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: If anything, I should be thanking ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Because I've renewed my resolve, too.
Because I was able to steel my res...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...How could I ever refuse?
choice_data_list: Please let me walk alongside you.
Please let me walk alongside you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I would love to have you beside me as
we
continue this journey...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, Mejiro Ardan and I go and speak
with her
physician.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text:
I hereby acknowledge both of your
intentions.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text:
As Lady Ardan's chief physician, I hereby
give her
my formal permission to return
to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much.
choice_data_list: Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text:
However, note that I may have to
rescind this decision in the event that
something were to
happen to Lady
Ardan again.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text:
...This is little more than my personal
opinion, but
I fully support the decision
you've both made.
choice_data_list: I am well aware.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to come to me with any
concerns you
might have. Now though, I
shall be taking my
leave.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, it sounds like he believes in
you as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. And so will I.
choice_data_list: I'll give it my all to live up to ...
I'll do my very best not to let th...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, Mejiro Ardan's nanny drives
the two
of us from the rest house back
to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you for dropping us off, Nanny.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
I've informed the master and mistress of
today's
developments.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh. I've just written Father and Mother a
letter
myself, to let them know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I shall message you once I've arrived at
the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
My lady. As you walk this path you've
committed
yourself to... please do take
care of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I shall. I'll not for a moment forget that
I've
chosen the steepest, most strenuous
path of all.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
I'll be thinking of you, always. Best of
luck to you.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: ...Please take good care of Lady Ardan.
choice_data_list: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan's nanny bows deeply upon
hearing
my response, then leaves
without uttering
another word.
choice_data_list: I will protect her, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming to see me today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now, concerning our plans moving
forward...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering if perhaps I could
trouble you to decide on each of the
races I'll be running during
my junior
year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. Because I've made a decision
of my
own today.
choice_data_list: Of course. But are you sure I can ...
Of course. But are you sure I can ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I've decided to pursue the future that
you have
laid out for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As such, I ask for your guidance on what I ought to focus on now, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Ardan...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing her say that, I feel as if Mejiro
Ardan...
might be placing a little more
trust in me than she
was before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My determination to support her grows
stronger
yet—she's putting her life in my
hands!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What Mejiro Ardan needs right now is
both
hands-on experience and the
physical capacity to
last an entire race.
choice_data_list: Let's get stronger, little by little.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During her junior year, I plan to have her
continue training as she accumulates
actual racing
experience at a pace that
suits her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Very well. In other words, it appears as
though it's
time for me to undergo quite
some rigorous
training.
choice_data_list: And let's aim for a stage where yo...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I shall be counting on you once again,
Trainer,
starting tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With both of us fully prepared for what
lies
ahead, Mejiro Ardan and I welcome
her junior
year!
